alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: GLORY·JZ green corridor; Glory Gallery, Milestone Plaza, Contributor Garden
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: A rotating public-memory program links railway history, present innovation and credited public contribution; content is submitted, rights-checked, human-curated, published, reviewed and withdrawable.
alignment_matrix.scenario_metric: Ten auditable AI scene cards (S01-S10); landmark_count=3; annual_program_count=3; scenario_node_count=8.

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: RD-SPINE greenway, three public-space landmarks and five scenario nodes
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: A normal-day/event-day switch uses bilingual route cards, accessible rest points and manual safety review; only opt-in anonymous aggregates inform route suggestions.

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: Zhongzhiyuan accelerator area, Dazhongsi industry cluster, and the two service/empowerment wings
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: Three differentiated test loops connect full-stack model governance, smart-native consumption/business and a public experience path; each loop has a named operator role, human gate and stop rule.
evidence_anchors: proposal.md#AI创新生态人才画像与AI场景

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: 众智园AI自主创新加速区 (KEY-ZHON)

evidence_anchors: proposal.md#AI创新生态人才画像与AI场景

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: AI原点社区 (KEY-BEIJ) and 中关村科技服务翼
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: An open call, case-library and service referral loop connects talent, space, data, compute, capital and scenes without naming or promising a specific enterprise, investor or policy allocation.
alignment_matrix.scenario_metric: global_case_count=8; annual_program_count=3; persona_count=8; evidence is a proposed mechanism, not an implementation claim.
evidence_anchors: proposal.md#统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: Glory Gallery, Milestone Plaza, Contributor Garden and Xiaoyuehe scenario empowerment wing
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: A scenario card starts with an opt-in input, produces an explainable public-space aid, passes human review, publishes a plain-language notice and can be withdrawn.

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: RD-SPINE slow corridor and three landmark public-space modules
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: Normal-day rest, learning and contribution display can switch to event-day programming; accessible route information, manual stewards and public notices keep the public realm usable without individual tracking.
alignment_matrix.scenario_metric: green_ratio=0.110044; public_space_ratio=0.003167; annual_program_count=3; all geometry-derived values are provisional.
evidence_anchors: proposal.md#蓝绿空间公共空间与城市风貌

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: Contributor Garden governance board, Zhongzhiyuan governance log and all three public nodes
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: The public governance kit uses anonymized aggregates only, human review for key decisions, no excessive monitoring, a public register, complaint/withdrawal channel and an exit record.
alignment_matrix.scenario_metric: Ten AI scenario cards carry human_review and exit_condition fields; privacy and rights assumptions are recorded in assumptions.json and risk.json.

alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: A public learning and contribution interface translates ecosystem knowledge into bilingual, accessible community programs; no organization or built facility is claimed.
alignment_matrix.scenario_metric: persona_count=8; scenario_card_count=10; annual_program_count=3; route and display content remain proposed until rights and site review.

alignment_matrix.taskbook_term_zh: 众智园AI自主创新加速区
alignment_matrix.taskbook_term_en: Zhongzhiyuan AI Self-directed Innovation Accelerator Area
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: The full-stack chain in district_ai_matrix is staged as a reversible test protocol with a data steward, model owner, evaluator and governance reviewer.
alignment_matrix.scenario_metric: district_ai_matrix[0]; function_count=5; deployment is conditional on human review and thresholds.

alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: A proposed smart-native consumption/business loop supports wayfinding, time-slot suggestions and low-intrusion service information, with shop/office operators and district operations reviewing every outward-facing change.
alignment_matrix.scenario_metric: district_ai_matrix[1]; one test loop has an input/output, review gate and complaint/safety exit.

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: Regional service interface linked conceptually to AI Origin Community and the corridor nodes
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: A referral and review mechanism connects public calls, technical support, knowledge assets and rights checks; it does not promise capital,招商 or institutional participation.

alignment_matrix.spatial_carrier: RD-SPINE greenway, public-space scenario nodes and the three GLORY·JZ landmarks
alignment_matrix.operating_mechanism: A public experience path moves from route choice to accessible rest/learning/display points and back to a human steward; community liaison and safety lead can pause the service.

district_ai_matrix.district: 众智园AI自主创新加速区
district_ai_matrix.district_en: Zhongzhiyuan AI Self-directed Innovation Accelerator Area
district_ai_matrix.space: KEY-ZHON concept area; a reversible public test-room interface, not a claimed facility
district_ai_matrix.operator_subject: Conceptual roles: data steward, model owner, evaluator, deployment steward, governance reviewer; no enterprise is named.
district_ai_matrix.input: Approved public or participant-submitted model cards, anonymized aggregate test requests, and documented benchmark tasks.
district_ai_matrix.output: Versioned result card, evaluation log, deployment decision, public plain-language notice, or a stop/revise record.
district_ai_matrix.human_review: Data steward checks permitted use; domain evaluator checks quality and bias; governance reviewer approves deployment and public notice.
district_ai_matrix.exit_condition: Stop and disable the endpoint when quality/safety threshold fails, consent is withdrawn, a complaint is unresolved, or the test window closes; archive/delete data according to the approved record.

district_ai_matrix.space: KEY-DAZH concept area, corridor-facing service points and event-day information surfaces
district_ai_matrix.operator_subject: Conceptual roles: shop or office operator, visitor, district operations steward and safety reviewer; no real business or tenant is asserted.
district_ai_matrix.input: Opt-in anonymous requests, published opening information, manual queue/wayfinding observations and aggregated event notices; no individual identity or private business data.
district_ai_matrix.output: Bilingual wayfinding card, suggested time window, accessible route/rest-point note, or a manual service-board update.
district_ai_matrix.human_review: The operator verifies the plain-language content; district operations checks safety and accessibility; the reviewer can reject, edit or keep the prior notice.
district_ai_matrix.exit_condition: Pause recommendations when a privacy complaint, unsafe crowding signal, accessibility failure or stale input is reported; revert to a manually authored public notice until reviewed.

district_ai_matrix.space: RD-SPINE greenway → public-space scenario nodes → Glory Gallery/Milestone Plaza/Contributor Garden; conceptual public experience path
district_ai_matrix.operator_subject: Residents, families, students, visitors, volunteers and community liaison/safety lead; the path is a proposal, not a built route.
district_ai_matrix.input: Opt-in anonymous pulse feedback, accessibility requests, manual counts and published event/route information; no face, device or individual trajectory collection.
district_ai_matrix.output: Bilingual route card, rest and accessibility point suggestion, event dispersal note, and a human-readable feedback update.
district_ai_matrix.human_review: Community liaison checks relevance and inclusion; safety lead checks route condition and event conflict; a steward provides a non-digital alternative.
district_ai_matrix.exit_condition: Pause a route suggestion when accessibility complaints exceed the locally agreed review threshold, a route condition changes, or the event closes; issue a manual notice and log the revision.

land_use_recalculation.formula: area(transform(feature geometry, EPSG:4548)) aggregated by land_use_code / area(transform(provisional site boundary, EPSG:4548))
land_use_recalculation.display_rule_zh: 按源图层已有 land_use_code 聚合；0802 仅标为科研，0801 教育和其他类在本层不存在，因此不新增、不虚构、不静默合并；0803 文化单列。green_space.geojson 是独立绿地覆盖层，不与 1401 用地面积相加。
land_use_recalculation.display_rule_en: Aggregate only the land_use_code values present in the source layer. 0802 remains scientific research; no absent 0801 education or other class is invented or silently merged, and 0803 culture stays separate. The green_space.geojson overlay is not added to the 1401 land-use area.
land_use_recalculation.rounding_note: Figures display one decimal percentage point; structured values retain ten-decimal ratios and three-decimal square metres. Displayed percentages sum to 100.0%.

site_area_sqm.star_note_en: * provisional concept value for package recomputation and comparison only; recompute with the same formula after official boundary release.
